How does AI Living differ from a standard smart home?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					AI Living is different from a standard smart home because it can learn user behavior and responding proactively, instead of acting on user commands with automation.
• AI Living’s learning capabilities can enable smart home monitoring and personal safety based on your routines.

• It also extends beyond the home into your everyday life by providing daily wellbeing insights to help you live better.

Can I use AI Living with non-Samsung products?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Yes, AI Living can be used with third-party devices that aren't from Samsung. 
• SmartThings supports Matter, allowing you to connect non-Samsung products such as lights, locks and cameras.

					The AI features available through AI Living are made easy for everyone to use, even seniors or children.

• Bixby allows for voice control, and other options help simplify the controls to support all users, even if they're elderly living alone.

Can I use AI features on older Samsung products?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					It may be possible to use AI features on older Samsung products, but there are things to keep in mind.
• Some features can be supported on older devices via software updates, particularly when using connected devices and content sharing.
• Certain advanced features may be limited to newer Samsung products.

Does AI Living update continuously?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Yes, AI Living continuously updates to help ensure an improved user experience over time, but some updated features are only available on the latest Samsung products.

How can I simplify senior care with AI Living?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					AI Living features help your family provide elder care for aging loved ones both remotely or at home.
• SmartThings Family Care helps with senior safety monitoring by checking their daily movement like their step count.
• You can also check your parents' daily activities by tracking appliance usage: fridge, TV, washing machine, oven or smartphones.
• You can also offer meaningful remote care by sending reminders for medicine or appointments, helping them maintain their health and wellness.

What information can I check while on a call with my aging parents?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					When speaking to your parents on the phone, the Care on Call feature gives you the ability to do a more comprehensive senior wellbeing check in real time, monitoring your parents' daily activity and see what's happening in their area.

• Stay updated on their latest movements with activity tracking.
• Track their steps to know their physical activity levels for the day.
• You can also view the current weather conditions at their location.

					AI Living Family provides a comprehensive safety net for elderly care through proactive monitoring and emergency response capabilities including:

• Receiving a ""First Activity Notification"" to confirm your parents have started their day without any issues.
• First Activity Alert: Provided when the ward’s activity tracking device detects movement after 4:00 AM.
• If no activity is detected for a certain period (outside of their usual routine) the system sends an alert to the emergency contact, allowing for a quick response to potential problems.
• Inactivity Alert: Provided if no activity is detected within the set monitoring interval (Default: 8 hours; 4 or 2 hours also available).
• In a crisis, you can use the camera and audio from their robot vacuum to remotely navigate the house, locate your parent and speak with them directly to assess the situation.

How do I register medication reminders or hospital appointments?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					You can register a parent's medication reminders and hospital appointments directly on your smartphones to assist in providing care for aging parents.

• For hospital appointments, register the hospital name and location as well as the date and time of your visit.

• Streaming: Various programs and series on streaming services.

Are my private files shared when connecting my phone with family members' devices?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					No, they are not shared even when creating a multi-device setup at home.
• User approval is required to share files or content between connected devices. This means when you're cross-device sharing, only what you want to share will be seen by another device.
• The built-in Knox security solution helps block access from unauthorized devices, so your private files stay private, even on a shared network.

How can I save energy with AI Living?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					It's easy to save energy with AI Living — just activate AI Saving Mode in SmartThings and you are able to track energy usage and reduce energy consumption.
• AI Saving Mode helps each device's energy usage based on its functions, such as adjusting the temperature of your washing machine and dryer or controlling the TV's brightness. 
• When you leave the house, AI Saving Mode automatically turns off unneeded devices for energy efficiency.

What information is sent to my family when I send a mobile SOS alert?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					SmartThings safe is a personal safety feature that alerts family members so they can respond quickly in an emergency.
• A precise map view showing your current location
• Direct buttons to call or text the person in need

How does Call Screening protect me from scam calls?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Call Screening helps protect you by having AI take calls from unknown numbers before you pick up.

• Enable Call screening and when an unknown number calls AI will answer, asking the caller who they are and why they are calling. You can see their responses transcribed into text on your screen in real time.
• Based on the responses, you can choose to take the call or end it immediately, preventing any direct contact with potential scammers.
• For added security, you can configure the settings to automatically block calls that are suspected of being spam or voice phishing.
